description: Toy example: one reading from a public sensor, such as an air-quality station. Replace with your own lexicon under a domain you control.

metric.description: What was measured, for example co2 or pm25.

value.description: Measured value as an integer in the given unit. DAG-CBOR has no floats, so pick a unit that avoids fractions.

unit.description: Unit of value, for example ppm or ug/m3.
